python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0001:
# Cabinet is to the right: let check beige / wood color in obs_0001, obs_0002
for name in ["obs_0001", "obs_0002", "obs_0008", "obs_0016", "obs_0017", "obs_0018", "obs_0019"]:
    arr = np.array(Image.open(f"/work/observations/{name}.png"))
    # Cabinet body color (beige / tan):
    cab_mask = (arr[:, :, 0] > 160) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 210) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 140) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 185) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 110) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 155)
    y, x = np.where(cab_mask)
    if len(x) > 50:
        print(f"Cabinet in {name}: x=[{x.min()}, {x.max()}], cx={x.mean():.1f}, y=[{y.min()}, {y.max()}]")
'
